prompt: The castle while it is being built, seen from high above at a three-quarter angle: the keep stands, the ring of walls is half done, one straight wall piece hangs from a wooden crane over a gap in the ring, timber scaffolds along an unfinished tower, wooden crates of timber and stacks of iron bars on the grid tiles beside it. Paint the near castle of the attached image, the one in the lower left with the square keep, the timber lookout under an orange pyramid roof and the red flag, as the only castle of a new picture, in the same soft painterly 2D look and colours. Keep its keep, roofs, walls and towers as they are in the attached image. No cannon fires, no smoke from any gun. No text, no letters, no numbers, no title, no watermark. Soft colours, not oversaturated, not a 3D render.
